description_expanded: AboutLuxury 30A Vacation Rental | Brand-New 6-Bedroom Coastal Home with Private Pool Near Seaside Welcome to The Suite Life on 30A, your dream getaway along Florida’s Scenic Highway 30A. This brand-new, never-before-rented 6-bedroom, 8-bathroom luxury vacation rental is the perfect retreat for families and groups seeking upscale comfort, modern design, and easy access to the sugar-white sands of the Emerald Coast. Ideally located near Seaside, boutique shopping, and some of the area’s most renowned restaurants, this home offers the ultimate 30A beach vacation experience. Property Highlights: • 6 bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom (plus 2 additional half baths) • Add a street-legal golf cart and receive 10% off the golf cart rental rate • Sleeps 13 comfortably – ideal for large families or multi-generational groups • Private pool with sun shelf featuring in-pool loungers, fenced-in backyard, outdoor shower, and pool and patio seating • Outdoor grill and corn hole – perfect for entertaining and relaxing • Coastal luxury décor with modern finishes and high-end furnishings • Open concept living area and two spacious living rooms for plenty of gathering space • Fully stocked gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, stone countertops, and all essentials for cooking and entertaining • Multiple balconies offering beautiful views and refreshing sea breezes • Family-friendly amenities including kids’ games, boogie boards, cooler, high-quality beach wagon, backpack beach chairs, and a beach umbrella • 6 adult bikes included for easy cruising to nearby shops, cafes, and beach access Outdoor Living at Its Best: The backyard at The Suite Life on 30A is designed for relaxation and entertainment. Take a dip in the sparkling private pool with a sun shelf, stretch out on the poolside loungers, or enjoy dining outdoors with a fresh-caught seafood meal prepared on the gas grill. After a day at the beach, rinse off in the private outdoor shower, challenge friends to a game of corn hole, or relax with a cool drink in hand. Spacious Coastal Design: This three-story home combines coastal elegance and family-friendly comfort. The main living area boasts soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and an open floor plan perfect for entertaining. The second living room provides additional space for kids, games, or multi-family groups, while the gourmet kitchen comes fully equipped for any culinary creation. Each of the six ensuite bedrooms is thoughtfully designed with plush bedding, stylish furnishings, and spa-like bathrooms. With three king suites, two queen suites, and a custom bunk room, The Suite Life on 30A comfortably accommodates up to 13 guests. Prime 30A Location: Just a short walk or bike ride to the nearest beach access, this home offers the perfect blend of privacy and convenience. You’ll be close to the iconic community of Seaside, known for its charming town square, boutique shopping, family-friendly activities, and some of the best dining along 30A. Whether you’re seeking a relaxing poolside retreat, a fun-filled beach vacation, or evenings exploring 30A’s vibrant dining and nightlife, this newly built luxury vacation rental has it all. Book your stay now at The Suite Life on 30A and be among the very first guests to experience this stunning 30A beach house.
